acceptance_criteria.criterion: Migration 040 prod'da uygulandiktan sonra tenant_settings tablosunda iki yeni JSONB sutun bulunur: clinic_contact JSONB DEFAULT '{}' + team_members JSONB DEFAULT '[]'. Postcondition INV-SEED-029..031 PASS (sutun varlik + Dent seed satir kontrolu + canonical mirror sync). arch/db/tenant-settings.sql canonical mirror update.

Dent seed (Migration 040 sonu): tenant_settings.clinic_contact 5 alan (phone +90 545 343 09 09, website https://dentadavista.com, instagram, facebook, address Kusadasi/Aydin) + team_members 2 uye (Dr. Ozge Yilmazoglu role=dentist + Gunes role=receptionist, language=en, pronouns=she/her, title belirtilmis). Existing tenant'lar icin '{}' ve '[]' default kalir (multi-tenant guvenli).

DynamicMessageResolver iki yeni namespace destekler: {{clinic.phone}}, {{clinic.website}}, {{clinic.instagram}}, {{clinic.facebook}}, {{clinic.address}}, {{team.dentist.name}}, {{team.receptionist.name}}, {{team.dentist.title}}, {{team.receptionist.title}}. Render edildiginde tenant_settings tablosundan 5dk MemoryCache TTL ile okur (TFM precedent), fallback bos string (alan yoksa template render bozulmaz). Backward compatibility: mevcut {{name}}, {{cf1}}..{{cf10}}, {{campaign.*}} lookup path'i bozulmaz; namespace genisletmesi additive.

FAQ + welcome metinleri icindeki hardcoded string'ler placeholder'a donusturuldu (Migration 040 sonu SQL UPDATE): 'Dr. Ozge Yilmazoglu' -> {{team.dentist.name}}, '+90 545 343 09 09' -> {{clinic.phone}}, 'https://dentadavista.com' -> {{clinic.website}}, 'Dublin (14 March)' -> {{campaign.cities[0].name}} ({{campaign.dates[0] | format}}). Smoke: Dent icin render edildiginde eski metin ile birebir ayni cikti (regression yok).

Dashboard /settings/clinic-metadata sayfasi: iletisim bilgileri formu (5 input phone/website/instagram/facebook/address) + team members CRUD (ekle/duzenle/sil/siralama/dil dropdown TR/EN/AR/DE/FR + diger) + form validation phone E.164 format URL valid. Cross-tenant 403 guard. Backend GET/PUT /api/v1/tenant-settings/clinic-metadata endpoint tenant-scoped.

Multi-tenant validation: 2. test tenant acilir (mock veya gercek), Dashboard uzerinden clinic_contact + team_members doldurulur, mevcut Dent FAQ template'leri o tenant icin render edildiginde DOGRU klinik bilgilerini gosterir (Dent'inkini DEGIL). Pre-existing Dent render aynen calismaya devam eder (no regression).

verification_questions.question: DynamicMessageResolver namespace genislemesi mevcut {{name}}, {{cf1}}..{{cf10}}, {{campaign.*}} lookup path'lerini bozar mi? Backward compatibility nasil korunuyor (existing template'ler regression test'i ile dogrulanmis mi)?

team_members JSONB array icinde ayni role iki kayit varsa (orn. 2 dentist) {{team.dentist.name}} hangisini doner? Determinism guarantee var mi (array order persistence + first-match rule)? Multi-dentist klinikler icin {{team.dentist[0].name}} vs {{team.dentist[1].name}} index syntax destekleniyor mu yoksa Phase 2 backlog mi?

Tenant A koordinatoru PUT /api/v1/tenant-settings/clinic-metadata ile tenant B JSONB'ini modify etmeyi denerse hangi katman engeller (JWT TenantContext ctx.Items + endpoint inline tenant_id filter + SQL WHERE tenant_id = @tid)? Cross-tenant guard layered defense?

Migration 040 prod'da calistirildiginda mevcut 36 FAQ + 15 welcome variant SQL UPDATE'i bir kismi basarisiz olursa transaction rollback olur mu (BEGIN/COMMIT atomic) yoksa partial state mi kalir? Idempotent re-run safe mi (ALTER TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + UPDATE WHERE clause)?
